items.title: Jack Grealish transfer update as ‘Everton return plunged into doubt’ after England star returns to Man City training
items.summary: JACK GREALISH's transfer to Everton has reportedly been plunged into doubt. The former England international has returned to training with Manchester City despite the uncertainty over his future. Grealish, 30, is expected to leave the Etihad Stadium this summer after falling down the pecking order.
